test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 26 July 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
The following sentence has been divided into parts. One of them may contain an error. Select the part that contains the error from the given options. If you don’t find any error, mark ‘No error’ as your answer.

Other South African cities only / had one venue for staging exhibitions or / international events at highly standard.

options.text: had one venue for staging exhibitions or

solution:
The correct answer is 'international events at highly standard.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The error lies in 'international events at highly standard' of the sentence.
 
• The word '**highly**' is used to define something to a **large degree**, or at a high level
 
 
• Example- The statement was made by a highly placed official.
 
 
 
• The word '**high**' refers to 'being a large distance from top to bottom (especially of things that are not living)'.
 
 
• Example- The garden is surrounded by a high wall.
 
 
 
• Therefore, the use of 'highly' in **last part** should be replaced with 'high' to make it grammatically correct.

 

Correct sentence__: *Other South African cities only had one venue for staging exhibitions or international events at **high** standard.*
